title: Hexagonal circular webs with a nonplanar smooth-conic-and-line polar curve
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: Exhaustiveness requires coordinating the nine real incidence types relative to the Darboux quadric, polar-congruence constraints, Mobius normalization, and the real-factor/zero-curvature exclusions. The full classification and its geometric reduction are kept as one unit, rather than splitting explicit cubic factorizations into mechanical exercises.
